response.text:
Here is what is due in the next four weeks, soonest first.

**With a due date**

- Service charge back-payment to Wohnbau Musterstadt, due Fri 9 Oct 2026: 184.30 € [item:itm_d6mp7bnzdzjw].
- Extension fee at the Ausländerbehörde appointment, due Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30: 100.00 € [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m]. Pay by girocard on site, because cash is not accepted.
- Health and care insurance contribution (Muster BKK), due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 156.55 € [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe]. It is collected by direct debit, so make sure your account has enough funds.
- Electricity advance payment (Stadtwerke), due Thu 15 Oct 2026: 48.00 € [item:itm_kttk9625293w]. It is also collected by direct debit.

**Open, but Ordnung has no due date stored**
- Monthly rent: 640.00 € [item:itm_b1b5643x7qy7].
- Rental deposit (Kaution): 1,560.00 € [item:itm_61wt30mrhybv]. It can optionally be paid in three instalments.
- Library overdue fees: 4.50 € [item:itm_kgsfgwac9wzx]. Pay them when you return the items.
- FitWell monthly membership fee: 29.90 € [item:itm_chhc59r0d16v]. It is collected by direct debit.

**Do not pay yet**
- A demand for 254.35 € from "Rundfunk-Beitragsservice Zahlungszentrale" [item:itm_zzenc1ydsw7g]. Its letter shows scam signs, including hidden text and an instruction not to contact the known Beitragsservice. Don't pay it until you have checked with the sender, using contact details you already have. A genuine sender whose bank details changed would show the same signs.

You can mark payments as done in Ordnung once you have paid them.
